label: Governing power in a commission
resolution: The original Commissions proofs use the unchanged narrow fixed table and ChurchFoundedInCommissionedApostles. New analyst calibration propositions expose the teaching-inclusive criterion and precise further extension; matching InstitutionLinkFor is a separate open premise. Under the broader criterion, Matthew 28 alone supplies a governing witness, but only the broader institutional bridge turns it into founding in a mandate. The old nonempty message model satisfies narrow bridge and Matthew 28 while rejecting the broader bridge. No source claim, all-powers coverage, report-to-event truth or actual jurisdiction is inferred by lexical reclassification.
